messages:
jess: Morning — quick sync. AWS/GCP/Azure asked for explicit account IAM roles and a separate billing contact for each marketplace listing. They want a CSV mapping of publisher account -> role ARN/service account -> billing email. Can we get owners + AMs today? @kevin @anna-legal :eyes:

kevin: got it. I'll pull current publisher account list and quay the AM owners. ETA 2pm PT. Do we have the mapping format they prefer? example?

jess: they gave this minimal example:

```
publisher_account,cloud,role_identifier,billing_email,am_owner
redwood-prod,aws,arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MarketplacePublisher,billing+aws@redwood.com,@kevin
redwood-gcp,gcp,serviceAccount:marketplace-pub@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com,billing+gcp@redwood.com,@sara
```

anna-legal: note — for Azure we require contract contact + MSA reference. I'll prep the MSA clause snippet. ping me the publisher account IDs.

lee-product: Also, packaging note — for GCP we need to set the support URL in the listing and it pulls the billing contact if left blank. Let's confirm the canonical contact.

kevin: uploading partial CSV to the shared drive now: https://drive.company/repo/link (placeholder). Tagging @ops for IAM provisioning.

ops-oncall: We'll need a short window to create service accounts/roles. Preferred times: 6-8pm PT tonight. If approved we can script creation via terraform:

```
module "pub_iam" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/terraform/modules/marketplace-iam"
  for_each = var.publisher_accounts
}
```

jess: can we hit tonight? AMs confirmed availability. @anna-legal will you OK MSA clause for Azure?

anna-legal: yes, quick thumbs up. I'll post the clause in this thread in 30m. :white_check_mark:

kevin: thanks team — I'll update the CSV and loop in sales/AMs for final billing emails. tagging @sara and @michael-sales
